constraints.note: Mike's brief: 'Every clip must be UNDER 60 seconds final runtime (hard cap, overrides the 3-minute default). Skip the longform.' Applied as a hard cap on the RAW cut, before tighten and desilence: every clip's est_seconds is under 60 (longest is clip 1 at 58.86s raw, with roughly 9s of dead air inside its first segment), so final runtimes can only land lower. No clip-count limit was given: 6 fulls plus 1 impact (robots). Clips 5 and 6 are the weakest; they are forward-looking coin hype kept for Mike to overrule, not filler I am confident in.

topics.hook_summary: This one is dedicated to all y'all haters out there. I had haters in my own Discord hating on this play, and I'm like, look what we did: 50K, went up, doubled our money. It was at 50K yesterday and it's at 101K today, it is definitely not dead. If the market cap goes to 5 million, that's a 100x from yesterday.

topics.hook_type: personal conviction story + data-anchored community win
topics.hook_summary: There's a backstory with the 89x on Pippin in a bear market. It was a play of mine from early 2025 and it seemed to have gone dead in August: the Twitter went dead and the centralized exchange listings went dead. Then Pippin started ripping, we're getting pinged over and over and over again, oh my god, and eventually it was an 89x.

Nobody's safe, no job is safe. You have a robot in your house, you don't need a plumber, an electrician, a roofer, a gardener, a security guard. Somebody comes to your house to torture you for your crypto, you have a robot that can kill the bastard. We're in for an unimaginable future, and the good news is anybody here in crypto is probably going to be all set.

topics.hook_type: outsized prediction with a reason / inspiring
topics.hook_summary: Most people who are alive today might not ever see a day where we need to die. We're approaching it, probably conservatively in 2033: medical advancements are happening so fast that every year we age we're gaining back like three months. Imagine being a hundred years old and as healthy as a 20 year old.

Golden is gonna be pretty damn good. It should totally go up, just because of the amount of action it has going on with influencers and KOLs. If the bulls start running in the next couple of weeks, Golden Kitty probably wants to go up to like 50 million. That is gonna be a big, big pump, maybe 10x from here.

October is one of those plays that's gonna pump hard and you gotta get out really fast. The older one hit a 75 million market cap in the first week of October. The pumpkin coins pump at the end of October, the October coins pump at the beginning. I called this one at a 29K market cap, and everybody's going to want to buy back in in October.
